_note: Thresholds for scripts/check_llm_provider_health.py stall findings (2026-10-15, DeepSeek held or 503'd every bridge call from 00:33Z while llm_provider_health.json said OK). Stalls are read from the provider_cost event ledger, which records every bridge attempt. A provider stalls when its newest consecutive_threshold attempts are TIMEOUT/5xx-overload, or more than ratio_threshold of its attempts in the last window_minutes stalled (with at least min_events_for_ratio attempts). DEGRADED (a lane is down, every caller has another) goes to the digest at priority_degraded; CRITICAL (some process has no allowed lane left) pages at priority_all_lanes_down.
